description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples for the RecognizeAction operation
description_zh: 本文介绍动作行为识别RecognizeAction的语法及示例
name: RecognizeAction

parameters.help_en:
The input content type, which can be video or image.

0: indicates a video URL or Base64-encoded video string.

1: indicates an image URL or Base64-encoded image string.

Other values: invalid input
parameters.help_zh:
输入内容类型，包括视频和图像两种类型。

0：表示输入视频URL或视频Base64编码字符串。

1：表示输入图像URL或图像Base64编码字符串。

其他：非法输入
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The video URL to input when Type is set to 0. We recommend that you use an China (Shanghai) region OSS URL. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS region other than China (Shanghai), see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: Type为0时需要输入的视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

fields.help_en: The image URL to input when Type is set to 1. You must input exactly 4 images, and the 4 images should be uniformly sampled from a 2-second video. The resolution and number of channels must be consistent. We recommend that you use an China (Shanghai) region OSS URL. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS region other than China (Shanghai), see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
fields.help_zh: Type为1时需要输入的图像URL地址，必须输入4张图像，且4张图像建议为两秒钟视频均匀采样的图像，分辨率和通道数必须一致。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The Base64-encoded image string. When both this parameter and URL are specified, URL takes priority. For information about Base64 encoding, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
fields.help_zh: 图像Base64编码字符串，与URL共存时，URL优先。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
fields.name: image_data

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded video string. When both this parameter and VideoURL are specified, VideoURL takes priority. For information about Base64 encoding, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频Base64编码字符串，与VideoURL共存时，VideoURL优先。文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
parameters.name: video_data

Elements.description_en: The list of returned result elements

Boxes.description_en: The list of bounding boxes for the specific action
Boxes.description_zh: 具体动作的坐标框列表

items.description_en: The bounding box coordinates of the specific action
items.description_zh: 具体动作的坐标框信息

items.description_en:
The confidence score of the behavior category. Valid values: 0 to 1. A higher value indicates a more accurate recognition result. The system provides threshold standards for different actions based on algorithms. You can also adjust the threshold standards based on your actual needs.

Raising hand: 0.5 (A value lower than 0.5 indicates the behavior is not raising hand. Otherwise, it is raising hand.)

Eating/drinking: 0.5 (A value lower than 0.5 indicates the behavior is not eating/drinking. Otherwise, it is eating/drinking.)

Smoking: 0.5 (A value lower than 0.5 indicates the behavior is not smoking. Otherwise, it is smoking.)

Making phone calls: 0.5 (A value lower than 0.5 indicates the behavior is not making phone calls. Otherwise, it is making phone calls.)

Using phone: 0.5 (A value lower than 0.5 indicates the behavior is not using phone. Otherwise, it is using phone.)

Sleeping on desk: 0.5 (A value lower than 0.5 indicates the behavior is not sleeping on desk. Otherwise, it is sleeping on desk.)

Falling down: 0.5 (A value lower than 0.5 indicates the behavior is not falling down. Otherwise, it is falling down.)
Washing hands: 0.5 (A value lower than 0.5 indicates the behavior is not washing hands. Otherwise, it is washing hands.)
Taking photos: 0.5 (A value lower than 0.5 indicates the behavior is not taking photos. Otherwise, it is taking photos.)
items.description_zh:
行为类别的置信度。取值范围0~1，值越大，识别到的动作越准确。系统根据算法，为不同的动作给出判断的阈值标准，您也可以根据自己的实际情况，对判断的阈值标准进行调整。

举手：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是举手行为，否则认为是举手行为。）

吃喝：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是吃喝行为，否则认为是吃喝行为。）

吸烟：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是吸烟行为，否则认为是吸烟行为。）

打电话：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是打电话行为，否则认为是打电话行为。）

玩手机：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是玩手机行为，否则认为是玩手机行为。）

趴桌睡觉：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是趴桌睡觉行为，否则认为是趴桌睡觉行为。）

跌倒：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是跌倒行为，否则认为是跌倒行为。）
洗手：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是洗手行为，否则认为是洗手行为。）
拍照：0.5（低于0.5则认为不是拍照行为，否则认为是拍照行为。）

Timestamp.description_en: The timestamp indicating when the behavior occurs in the video or image
Timestamp.description_zh: 当前行为在视频或者图像中发生的时间戳信息
